validity.value: Photos must be recent ('photos récentes'); three recent colour ID photos required (four for emergency/urgent passport applications)

cross_verification.note_en: Gabon's Ministry of Foreign Affairs official site (affaires-etrangeres.gouv.ga/passeports) confirms passport applications require 'trois photos d'identité couleurs récentes' (three recent colour ID photos; four for emergency passports) but does not publish technical size/background/composition specifications. The Gabon Embassy in the US (gabonembassyusa.org, official diplomatic mission site) confirms one photo must be glued/stapled to the visa application form, likewise without technical specs. A private French visa-processing intermediary (visa-office.fr) hosts a form citing '35×45mm' but was excluded per the truthfulness gate since it is not an official government or embassy domain and its currency/accuracy could not be independently confirmed.
